clientDefect.runtimeEvidence: Main window/browser creation used the same native thread. It started as MAINSTA, then became implicit MTA after repeated libmpv destruction. Native CoUninitialize stacks originate in libmpv-2.dll without matching successful initialization on that thread.
clientDefect.reproduction: Five real Player instances are initialized and disposed; wait six seconds for media_kit delayed mpv_terminate_destroy, then create a cold source environment. Before fix, sequential resolve 1 fails with exact 0x800401F0.
clientDefect.fix: Explicit Flutter UIThreadPolicy::RunOnSeparateThread isolates Dart/mpv from native platform STA; no blind retry, COM refcount padding, cookie removal or TLS bypass.
clientDefect.maintenanceConstraint: Flutter 3.47.5 supports this policy but engine warns unmerged threads will be removed in future; verify and replace mpv/COM ownership before an SDK upgrade removes support.
